create_classification_dataset: create a random n-class classification dataset with configurable informative redundant and repeated features
build_clustering_blobs: build isotropic Gaussian blobs for clustering with configurable centers and cluster standard deviations
test_regression_generator: test a random regression problem generator with tunable noise effective rank and coefficient output
create_moons_dataset: create two interleaving half circles dataset for visualizing clustering and classification algorithms
build_circles_dataset: build a large circle containing a smaller circle dataset in 2d for visualizing clustering algorithms
